title: Tonpet
blurb: A new wind instrument somewhere between a trumpet and a bassoon. The sound isn't samples: it's a physical model of a lip-reed and a conical reed blowing through a modelled air column, so your breath into the mic shapes and sustains every note. Glide from brassy to woody with one dial.
controls: Hold a key to play. Turn on Mic breath and blow at the bottom of the phone, or slide the Air strip. Slide a finger sideways on a key to bend the pitch. Trumpet ↔ Bassoon dial sets the character, and Shape sets the key, scale, octave, vibrato and room. Computer: A–; and Q–T play, Space blows
